result_text:
I added `DataStore.findOverduePurchaseOrdersOfSupplier(long supplierId, LocalDate date)` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, next to the other overdue-order finders.

It reuses the existing overdue query filtered by supplier, the same way the warehouse version does. That means only sent orders count, the expected date must be strictly before the given date, and the order is earliest expected date first, then by id. Order lines come back through the existing `findPurchaseOrders` path.

I ran `OpenPurchaseOrdersTest` and it compiles and passes. I didn't add a test for the new method or check your 13 July example against it. The method reuses the same query as the existing overdue finders, so I expect it to behave the same.
